enonce_intro_markdown:
Two matrices M and N are such that $M=\begin{pmatrix}3&1\\2&5\end{pmatrix}$ and $N=\begin{pmatrix}a-1&1\\2&b+3\end{pmatrix}$

Find

questions.enonce_markdown: (a) the values of a and b given that $M=N$
questions.corrige_markdown:
Equal matrices have equal corresponding entries.

$a-1=3\Rightarrow a=4$.

$b+3=5\Rightarrow b=2$.

(The other entries, $1=1$ and $2=2$, already agree.)

**$a=4$ and $b=2$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (b) the transpose of M *[6 marks for the whole question]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The transpose swaps rows and columns: row 1 of $M$ $(3\;1)$ becomes column 1, and row 2 $(2\;5)$ becomes column 2.

**$M^T=\begin{pmatrix}3&2\\1&5\end{pmatrix}$.**
